changes.title: Sen. Darline Graham, Rep. Ralph Norman advance to GOP runoff in South Carolina
changes.summary: A first-time candidate who was always close to her brother's political orbit, Darline Graham overcame skepticism about her lack of experience in her campaign to replace him, as she moved forward Tuesday as the top vote-getter to runner-up Norman.
